scope: 8 remaining review comments: read-only evidence indexing (tasks 1-6,8) plus legitimate known-key defense deployment semantics measurement (task 7)
rules_binding: paper/comment files are not modified; no emails; no anonymous-mirror operations
no new key-recovery/attack-reproduction/attack-optimization runs; attack-side comments only index existing evidence, gaps stay open
no resampling: frozen main_public 3,000 list and lifecycle 100 IDs are reused; paired conditions do not add independent prompt denominators
GLM and all completed queues are not restarted
S/a v2 is accepted as-is (4,597 pass / 7,403 fail retained; original 2,306/6,000 vs refresh 2,291/6,000, 63 discordant pairs); it is not rerun and 'fully symmetric' phrasing is banned
valid negative results, errors and not_run are retained; acceptance = correct measurement + complete records
deleted materials are not restored from old paths; v1 dir inputs.jsonl remains the frozen text source

1_numeric_stability.question: sign-test norm gap, smallest coordinate-pair norm, projection residual, probe-change events, failed attempts/retries in retained records
1_numeric_stability.rule: quantities not saved are marked not_recorded; cosine/state-separation/w-error do not substitute

2_version_binding.question: 12 main-table configurations: run-bound checkpoint/tokenizer revision
2_version_binding.rule: current HF cache listings and today's loads are not historical bindings; no model reruns

3_timing_comparability.question: spectrum-control vs main-method wall-clock comparability
3_timing_comparability.rule: 512-token defense operation times never fill attack-cost cells; mixed total_time_s is not decomposed

4_miss_attribution.question: descriptive distribution of the 516,666 misses; per-block candidate/gap/collision diagnostics if saved
4_miss_attribution.rule: totals must still sum to 516,666; descriptive distribution is not mechanism attribution; missing per-block records stay mechanism_unidentified

5_component_costs.question: calibration time, dictionary construction time/memory, decoding time per 1,000 target tokens, hardware, threads, vocabulary
5_component_costs.rule: offline-load / one-time / per-target costs separated where recorded; no back-filling from mixed totals

6_scaling_claims.question: orthogonality assumption, ratio=1.25 point results, fixed-ratio results vs manuscript claims
6_scaling_claims.rule: claim/evidence/scope/gap listed per item; unproven generalization suggestions flagged for the author

8_baseline_matrix.question: matched baselines on the full protected-cache transform: input access, visible objects, metrics, task boundaries, measured failure conditions
8_baseline_matrix.rule: mechanism comparison is not head-to-head; no new baseline implementations or runs

task7_deployment_measurement.system_under_test: VeilKV defense codec (defense_runtime copy from release/defense-stage-v2pyknb7: exp_veilkv_plus.py, corrected/freshness.py, veilkv_runtime.py) run from this handoff directory; release stage itself is not modified

inputs.body: tokenizer(text)[:134]; continuation = last 6 real tokens consumed 2/3/1
inputs.sanity_first: first 5 IDs, separate sanity directory, all gates must pass before the full set

conditions.multi_turn: 100 IDs x 2 models x 2 dtypes x 3 segments = 1,200 segment keys (400 request keys): one VeilKV protect at prefill (TEE profile, epoch 3, per-request principal/nonce derived reproducibly), authenticated recovery, then the same 2/3/1 continuation through plain and protected branches; same-timestep whole-tensor logits compare vs plain cached and full forward; plain baseline independently cloned, all-layer K/V pollution checked
conditions.shared_prefix: 100 IDs x 2 models (fp32) = 200 keys: same policy-public prefix, two principals (A = this ID tail, B = next-ID tail, declared pairing); checks: public artifact_id equality, freshness-service public object identity/reuse, per-principal recovery equals its own plain cache (bytes/dtype), cross-principal nonce/tail binding rejected (TamperError), wrong-concatenation rejected
conditions.reencode: 100 IDs x 2 models (fp32) = 200 keys: recover -> re-protect under a fresh nonce and epoch 4 -> recover; cache-level equality vs plain, dtype/shape/format checks, old-epoch material rejected under new epoch, duplicate-nonce reuse rejected by the freshness service; the source interface's support for re-protection is declared
conditions.ledger: scripted scenarios on a dedicated test freshness DB: restart persistence of nonce registration, public-object consistency, concurrent same-nonce and distinct-nonce writes, event order and exit codes; software ledger explicitly not hardware rollback resistance
conditions.device: actual hardware probed (GPU present/absent); no GPU -> not_available with evidence; no simulated GPU passes
conditions.scheduler: repo/release searched for a real serving adapter; none found -> not_implemented; toy PageManager not substituted

task7_deployment_measurement.allowed_behaviors: test program holds every configuration/key legally; only protect/recover/state interfaces called
task7_deployment_measurement.forbidden_behaviors: no attacker-visibility claims; no freshness bypass to force passes; no mixing of plain state into protected branches; functional failures retained
task7_deployment_measurement.environment: experiments/kvcloak/.venv (python 3.12.3, torch 2.14.0+cpu, transformers 4.51.3); HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; model revision via AutoConfig._commit_hash at load; dedicated VEILKV_NONCE_DB under this directory
task7_deployment_measurement.workers: multi_turn sharded 4 shards x (model,dtype) = 16 processes x 4 threads; codec conditions single process; actual counts recorded in launcher_run.json

deliverables_final: task7 sanity + full outputs with PROTOCOL-first discipline
